This '''skirmish took place on [[Drunost]]''', when [[Bargleg swoop gang|Bargleg]] swoopgang, which was allied with [[BloodScar]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], tried to seize a weapons shipment that was being smuggle through [[Consolidated Shipping]] hub by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives. The Rebels&mdash;who were masquerading as simple farmers&mdash;were rescued by a [[Hand of Judgment|group]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserters. The stormtroopers destroyed the swoopgang and allowed the apparent farmers to go on their way&mdash;later they delivered their weapons to the Rebellion&mdash;before leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a hurry.
